correctness.rationale: The inclusive graph-distance classification gives K_1=the bipartite incidence graph. For K_2 the full point and full line simplices with individual incident stars form two contractible simplicial subcomplexes U,V and U intersection V=incidence graph. Integral simplicial Mayer–Vietoris yields H~_2(K_2;Z)=H_1(graph;Z), with an additional minus sign whenever a duality swaps the ordered U,V summands; no extra homology survives. Incidence count (q+1)(q^2+q+1)-2(q^2+q+1)+1=q^3. Signed incidence-chain Lefschetz traces are F-V+1 (part preserving) and F-1 (part exchanging), while H_1 has the opposite sign for the latter. Independently rebuilt the Fano 168 collineations plus duality coset, all 336 automorphisms, and counted all 8 character classes; the complete finite source verifier (331 faces and binary ranks 13,50,54,30,12,2) was inspected. Weighted character norm 1 and zero average establish absolute irreducibility and vanishing invariants. The matching-complex W equality is a rational character coincidence, not an integral isomorphism. No existence claim for unknown plane orders.
